gloss: to devise cleverly; to use ingenuity

definitions.gloss: to devise cleverly; to use ingenuity; to put thought and effort into
definitions.explanation: To apply creativity and careful thought to come up with something effective or inventive. Implies dedicated effort in the planning or design of something.

examples.japanese: {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした{料理|りょうり}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To prepare food with creative ingenuity.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}は{授業|じゅぎょう}に{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らして{生徒|せいと}を{飽|あ}きさせない。
examples.english: The teacher uses ingenuity in class to keep students from getting bored.

examples.japanese: デザイナーが{工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした{展示|てんじ}は、{来場者|らいじょうしゃ}から{高|たか}い{評価|ひょうか}を{受|う}けた。
examples.english: The cleverly devised exhibition by the designer received high praise from visitors.

notes:
A set expression combining {工夫|くふう} (ingenuity, device) with {凝|こ}らす (to concentrate, to elaborate). The verb {凝|こ}らす conveys putting concentrated effort into something, so the expression emphasizes dedicated creative thinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした{料理|りょうり} — creatively prepared food
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らしたデザイン — ingeniously crafted design
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした{授業|じゅぎょう} — a well-thought-out lesson
- {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした{演出|えんしゅつ} — cleverly devised production/staging

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {工夫|くふう}する — to devise, to think up (simpler; less emphasis on elaborate effort)
- {趣向|しゅこう}を{凝|こ}らす — to exercise one's ingenuity (similar structure; focuses on creative taste)
- {知恵|ちえ}を{絞|しぼ}る — to rack one's brains (emphasizes the difficulty of thinking)

USAGE:
Often appears in the past participle form {工夫|くふう}を{凝|こ}らした as a modifier before nouns, describing something that is the product of careful creative effort.
